title: Contract work becomes a measurable state machine
subtitle: Observable states, approval gates, exception branches, and final verification make contract work measurable.

nodes.label: Intake
nodes.detail: Capture request details, thresholds, terms, and reviewers

nodes.label: Interpret rules
nodes.detail: Translate policy into forms, templates, and conditions

nodes.label: Route approvals
nodes.detail: Send required reviews according to business policy

nodes.label: Handle exception
nodes.detail: Identify nonstandard cases and surface them for review

nodes.label: Build agreement
nodes.detail: Assemble the contract using approved terms and rules

nodes.label: Verify result
nodes.detail: Check criteria and confirm the finished process works

callouts.label: Observable
callouts.detail: Each transition has a defined state, inputs, and completion proof.

callouts.label: Measurable
callouts.detail: Success is the verified agreement, not a plausible midstream step.

callouts.label: Governed
callouts.detail: Nonstandard cases branch to explicit human review.

flow_label: Rules persist through every workflow state
footer: The useful unit of evaluation is the end-to-end workflow with its business rules intact.
